items.q: The things that I saw on the news this weekend that I saw some officers commit – those were crimes," Don Scott said.

record.t: Is the first Black Speaker of the Virginia House of Delegates.
record.q: The first Black Speaker of the House of Delegates, Don Scott advocates for increased opportunities for all Virginians.
In 2022, he became House Democratic Leader, and in 2024, made history as the first Black Speaker of the Virginia House of Delegates 405 year history.

record.t: Won the District 80 race in the Virginia House of Delegates as a Democrat with 66.07% of the vote.
Was elected to the Virginia House of Delegates in 2019.
record.q: Elected to the House of Delegates in 2019, Don quickly emerged as a bold voice for change.

record.t: Is a member of the Virginia Legislative Black Caucus.
record.q: Don Scott is a member of Virginia Legislative Black Caucus – a group that's working on a legislative package to "tear down institutional racism in the criminal justice system.
